Eliminate six [[Charr Champion]]s in [[the Northlands]] before they can assault [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]].

== Quest information ==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
| minimum = 10
}}

===Objectives===
* Find and kill the [[Charr Champion]]s inside [[the Northlands]]. [6...0] remain.
* See [[Lieutenant Langmar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==NPCs==
=== Foes ===
[[Charr]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"We have heard reports that there are a number of Charr Champions up in the Northlands. Chances are the Charr are planning for something and have brought their finest warriors to be part of the attack. Rather than wait for the fight to come to us, we are going to get the upper hand by going north and killing the Charr's Champions, demoralizing them, and making them think twice before attacking. If you think you have what it takes to face these Charr Champions in battle, I will give you that opportunity. You cannot go alone, though. No one is permitted north of the wall without someone to watch their back!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = The bigger they are, the harder they fall!
| decline = I think this is a task better suited to someone with more experience or less brainpower.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
; Lieutenant Langmar
:''"Well Done! We have either made the Charr think twice before facing an Ascalonian in battle, or we have ensured their vengeance. Either way, I'm sure we shall be victorious regardless of what they throw at us!"''

==Notes==
* There are more than 6 potential spawn points. Another one is slightly east of the entrance from [[Lakeside County]]. Also spotted on the far east side past the double-bridge.
* The Champion Groups consist of a [[Charr Champion]], and 2 [[Charr]] which might be of any combination of the lower levels. For example, a [[Charr Fire Caller (Vanguard quest)|Charr Fire Caller]] and a [[Charr Stalker (Vanguard quest)|Charr Stalker]].
{{bug|When one charr champion remains, the quest text erroneously ends with ''1 remain.''}}

==Trivia==
* The location of the charr champions was changed in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260107|January 7, 2026 update]], because one of the locations was in [[Piken Square (landmark)|Piken Square]], which conflicted with the [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square outpost]] available in [[Reforged Mode]].
